title: Accounts Administrator
description:
We are working with a growing business who are looking to welcome an organised and enthusiastic Accounts Administrator to their finance team.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build their experience within a busy finance environment, develop their accounting knowledge and become an integral part of a supportive team.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will gain exposure to a variety of accounts and administrative activities, with ongoing training and guidance to help you develop your skills and take on further responsibilities.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Assisting with the processing of purchase and sales invoices
- Maintaining accurate customer and supplier account records
- Supporting the finance team with credit control and account administration
- Reviewing financial documents and checking information for accuracy
- Dealing with day-to-day accounts enquiries in a professional manner
- Providing general administrative support to the finance department
- Working alongside the Finance Manager to ensure the smooth running of daily accounts activities

Skills & Experience Required:
- A genuine interest in developing a career within accounts or finance
- A methodical approach with good attention to detail
- Confident IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office
- Strong communication and organisational abilities
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn
- The ability to manage tasks responsibly and work as part of a team
- Due to location of the role, a driving licence and access to own vehicle is required

If you're organised, enthusiastic and looking for an opportunity to develop your skills within a finance team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
I am recruiting a part-time Accounts Officer on behalf of a client in a regulated industry. You will help keep client money records accurate, make sure payments are made on time and investigate discrepancies through to resolution.

What you ll be doing
- Process and reconcile client money transactions, including payments, refunds, fees and commission.
- Reconcile third-party statements, prepare settlement payments and resolve queries within agreed timescales.
- Maintain accurate ledgers, allocate receipts and investigate outstanding or unallocated items.
- Support weekly and monthly bank reconciliations, as well as month-end and year-end reporting.
- Keep clear audit trails, follow approval procedures and escalate unusual transactions or discrepancies.
- Work with colleagues and external contacts to resolve account queries and improve finance processes.

What we re looking for
- AAT qualified or part-qualified, a similar qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
- A good grounding in bookkeeping and accounting, with strong numerical skills and attention to detail.
- A methodical approach to resolving discrepancies and the ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines.
- Clear communication skills and an understanding of confidentiality and data protection.

Experience in a regulated industry, familiarity with client money requirements, and experience with reconciliations, Excel or accounting systems would be an advantage. The position is being offered on a part-time basis of 21 hours a week with days/ hours to suit.

title: Credit Controller
company: Pure Resourcing Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Credit Controller
Hybrid Working Available
Free Parking, Flexible Hybrid Working, Competitive Salary & Benefits Package

Pure are recruiting for an experienced Credit Controller professional to join a busy and supportive finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building strong customer relationships, reducing aged debt, and supporting the wider finance function in a varied role.

Working within a collaborative environment, you'll take ownership of credit control activities while also supporting accounts receivable processes to ensure the timely collection and allocation of customer payments.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively manage and collect outstanding customer debt.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers to resolve payment queries.
- Monitor aged debt reports and follow up on overdue accounts.
- Allocate incoming payments and reconcile customer accounts.
- Raise and issue sales invoices and credit notes.
- Investigate and resolve invoicing and payment discrepancies.
- Prepare regular debtor reports and update cash collection forecasts.
- Support month-end processes and account reconciliations.
- Work closely with internal departments to ensure accurate billing and prompt query resolution.
- Maintain accurate customer account records and credit limits.

About You
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable, Sales Ledger or a similar finance role.
- Confident communicating with customers by phone and email.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high-volume workload.
- Good organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively.
- Competent user of finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Positive, proactive and professional approach to work.

If you're an experienced Credit Controller professional looking for your next opportunity within a supportive and flexible working environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Finance and Office Coordinator
description:
Are you an organised and proactive individual with experience in finance and office administration?

Finance and Office Coordinator

Location: Near Newmarket, Suffolk
Salary: Competitive, depending on experience (pro rata)
Hours: Flexible, hours per week
Contract Type: Permanent
Sector: Administration & Finance

Our client based near Newmarket are seeking a highly organised Finance and Office Coordinator.

This is a varied and rewarding role combining financial administration, office coordination, team support, marketing and event planning. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the business, supporting colleagues and helping to maintain a positive and sociable working environment.

The ideal candidate will be professional, dependable and confident managing financial records and administrative systems, whilst also bringing energy, initiative and excellent interpersonal skills to the role.

As the Finance and Office Coordinator, duties will include:
- Managing day-to-day financial administration
- Coordinating office systems, supplies, contracts, records and relationships with external suppliers and support providers.
- Providing administrative and document support
- Supporting recruitment
- Organising team and client events
- Maintaining and updating the company website
- Supporting the company's LinkedIn presence
- Providing administrative support for projects
- Acting as a central point of contact within the office

An ideal candidate for the Finance and Office Coordinator will have:
- Previous experience in finance administration, office administration or a varied coordination role.
- Strong organisational skills
- Confidence handling invoicing, expenses, timesheets and financial records.
- Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Excel and Word.
- Excellent communication skills, verbal and written.

Interviews will take place in Newmarket, following a registration process by PureKat Consultancy Ltd. If we have not responded to your application within 3-5 days, unfortunately you have not been successful on this occasion, but please feel free to contact us for other opportunities. PureKat Consultancy Ltd is acting as an Employment Agency for this permanent vacancy.

title: Transport Finance Administrator
